references.text: Moses wrote down this law and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who carried the ark of the Lord's covenant, and to all the elders of Israel. This verse shows the context for Moses' writing of the law.
The king shall write a copy of this law in a book. This highlights the importance of recording God's law in a book, as Moses did.
This Book of the Law must not depart from your mouth. Joshua is commanded to hold fast to the Book of the Law that Moses had written.
Joshua built an altar and wrote a copy of the Law of Moses on stones. This confirms that the Law of Moses was written down in a book.
Joshua wrote these words in the Book of God's law. This follows the tradition of recording God's words in a book.
The discovery of the Book of the Law in the temple during King Josiah's reign. Refers to the Book of the Law that Moses wrote.
Moses wrote down all the Lord's words. An earlier reference to Moses' writing of God's words.
The Lord said to Moses: Write these words down. Moses was commanded to write down the words of the covenant.
Moses recorded the starting points according to the Lord's command. Shows Moses' practice of recording important events.
Jesus says that Moses wrote about him. The New Testament confirms that Moses wrote down the words of the law.
